author: evac
description: Unified minigame spawner replacing cashdrop, hunting, lootdrop, and pupper. Spawns pet, mathdrop, hunt, lootdrop, reacttowin, and boss battle events in one fixed channel, with activity gating, per-user payout pacing, and a diagnostics command for tuning.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing MinigameHub!

Before enabling: `.minigamehub channel #your-channel` to confirm the spawn channel (defaults to the general chat channel from the design doc), then `.minigamehub toggle` to start spawning.

If you're migrating from cashdrop/hunting/lootdrop/pupper, run `.minigamehub migrate` first to pull over your existing settings, then unload the four old cogs.

Run `.minigamehub diagnostics` after a few days live to get tuned frequency/reward/cap suggestions based on your server's real activity.
name: MinigameHub
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-user game statistics (wins, streaks, boss damage, daily payout totals) and per-guild configuration. Use `.minigamehub wipestats` or `[p]mydata` to remove your data.
